# Northbeam Pricing and Plans

Northbeam offers three subscription tiers: Free, Pro, and Enterprise.

## Free Plan

The Free plan allows file uploads up to 25 MB per file. Users on the Free
plan can cancel at any time with no charges and no notice period.

## Pro Plan

The Pro plan raises the file upload limit to 100 MB per file. Pro plan
cancellation depends on billing frequency: monthly Pro cancellations take
effect at the end of the current billing period, while annual Pro
cancellations require 30 days' notice and are pro-rated for the unused
portion.

Switching from monthly Pro to annual Pro gives a 20% discount compared to
monthly billing. The switch takes effect immediately, with a pro-rated
credit for the unused portion of the current monthly billing period.
Monthly and annual Pro have identical features, so nothing is lost by
switching.

Downgrades from annual Pro to monthly Pro are not supported mid-contract.
Customers must wait until the end of the annual billing period, cancel,
and re-subscribe as monthly. Refunds for unused annual time are not issued
outside of statutory consumer protection rights.

## Enterprise Plan

The Enterprise plan raises the file upload limit to 500 MB per file.
Enterprise cancellations require 90 days' notice, and contract-specific
terms may apply.

Single Sign-On via Okta is available on the Pro and Enterprise plans.
Setup requires an admin to configure the SAML integration in Okta's admin
console using Northbeam's Entity ID (found in Account Settings -> SSO),
then upload the metadata XML back into Northbeam. Full setup usually takes
15-30 minutes.
